# On forms it had never seen, a small AI on one office PC found 92 of every 100 facts. {.hero-title}

It reads messy work orders and copies 9 facts from each one (work order number, date, equipment, cost and so on) into a
spreadsheet, so nobody has to retype them. This is called [extraction](glossary.qmd#extraction){.gl}. The documents never
leave the computer. All 50 are [SYNTHETIC](glossary.qmd#synthetic){.gl}, and every answer was marked against a hidden
[answer key](glossary.qmd#answer-key){.gl}.

::: {.stamp-copy}
## Nothing leaves this PC. The AI is only allowed to talk to its own computer.

The AI model (an [LLM](glossary.qmd#llm){.gl} called {{< var run.model >}}) runs inside a free program on the same PC.
The reading program sends text only to [localhost](glossary.qmd#localhost){.gl}, the computer's name for itself. It is
written to refuse any other address, and an automatic test checks that.

::: {.wtm}
**What this means for an office.** Client files are read where they already are. There is no cloud account, no upload
and no outside company holding a copy. One honest limit: the demo also downloads [public](glossary.qmd#public-data){.gl}
government recall data from the internet. That is never your documents, and one switch turns it off.
[How we know, and a draft paragraph for your security plan →](privacy.qmd)
:::
:::
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter}
## New forms cost the AI {{< var llm.drop >}} points. They cost the plain rules {{< var rules.drop >}}.

Half of the documents use [familiar layouts](glossary.qmd#seen-unseen){.gl}. The other half use new labels and wording
("Precedence" instead of "Priority", "Powerplant" instead of "engine"), like next month's forms from a new supplier.
The [plain rules](glossary.qmd#rules){.gl} were written while looking at the familiar half, so they are perfect there and
lost on the new half. The AI was not tuned on either.

{{< include _gen/seen_unseen.html >}}

::: {.wtm}
**What this means.** If every form you get looks the same, simple rules are enough. If layouts change, the AI keeps
working while rules quietly miss most of the page. "Found" here is [recall](glossary.qmd#recall){.gl}.
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter}
## On the same 25 new forms, the AI found {{< var llm.u_tp >}} facts. The plain rules found {{< var rules.u_tp >}}.

Each square is one fact from the answer key. Count the empty squares: those are facts nobody would have typed in.

{{< include _gen/units.html >}}

::: {.wtm}
**What this means.** The rules are cautious: when they answer, they are right {{< var rules.u_p >}}% of the time. But
they leave {{< var rules.u_blank >}} boxes blank. The AI answers almost everything and is right
{{< var llm.u_p >}}% of the time it answers (its [precision](glossary.qmd#precision){.gl}). That is why a person should
still check its work.
:::
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter}
## Where it slipped: {{< var wrong >}} of {{< var cells >}} boxes were wrong, and none were made-up numbers.

Every mistake fell into one of four causes. Each one has a likely fix.

{{< include _gen/causes.html >}}

::: {.wtm}
**What this means.** The AI never invented a labor hour or a dollar amount. Its only invented values are
{{< var dates_invented >}} dates, on emails that gave no report date. Priority on the new P1/P2/P3 wording is its weakest
box: treat it as "needs a look" until the fix is tested.
[See all {{< var wrong >}} with the real document text →](errors.qmd)
:::

[Also tested on real public text.]{.mini-h} On {{< var nhtsa.n >}} [NHTSA](glossary.qmd#nhtsa){.gl} vehicle recalls
([PUBLIC DATA]{.tag .tag-public}), the AI named the same broken part as NHTSA's own label {{< var nhtsa.match >}} times.
:::

::: {.hl-panel .chapter .finale}
## The bottom line

On forms it had never seen, a laptop-sized AI found **{{< var llm.u_r >}}%** of the facts where hand-written rules found
**{{< var rules.u_r >}}%**, without ever sending a page off the computer, and without inventing a single number.
It is a fast first draft, not a final answer: a person approves every value before it is used.

::: {.method}
**How this was measured (for reviewers).**

- 50 SYNTHETIC work orders from a seeded generator: 3 layouts (form, table, free-text email), 25 familiar and 25 new.
- The answer key was never shown to either method. Neither the rules nor the AI prompt changed after the new half was
  looked at. The familiar-form score ({{< var llm.s_r >}}% found) is never the headline.
- 9 boxes x 50 documents = {{< var cells >}} boxes. Precision = right answers / answers given. Recall = right answers /
  facts in the key. A wrong value counts against both.
- Model {{< var run.model >}} on a laptop CPU, temperature 0: {{< var run.calls >}} real calls, {{< var run.sec_per_call >}} s
  each on average. {{< var run.first_try >}} documents passed the checks first time, {{< var run.retried >}} on a retry, and
  {{< var run.fallback >}} fell back to the rules.
- 50 documents is a small test: one mistake moves a box's score by 2 to 4 points. Run date {{< var run.date >}}; tests
  {{< var run.pytest >}}. Source files: `docs/results.json` and `exports/*.csv`. This page is rebuilt from them and the
  build stops if any number disagrees.
:::
:::
